items.claim: values source reset ignores `over`, so an alias row's Reset does nothing
items.note: This adds an optional `PrefsSource.over`, so it is a `minor` changeset.

items.claim: writing `undefined` to a split pref wipes every option and drops `at`
an auto-capable enum is accepted as a selector and holds `undefined` while auto
items.note: My call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under round fifty-three: such a selector is refused with code `auto` unless its `auto.value` is one of its options. The alternative was to read its auto as its default.

items.claim: `unitScopedPrefUnit` loses its scale to a large offset
`createDefaultsSource` reads a leaf that starts auto at its `default`
items.note: It now reads through the same function a store uses.

items.claim: a write at one option of a split auto leaf rebuilds from `defaultScope`
`setAuto(false)` pins a split leaf that is auto only under the current option
items.note: It has the same cause as the finding above, so one fix covers both.

items.claim: a split color holding names or `rgb()`/`hsl()` strings snaps to its heaviest member instead of mixing
a store from `usePrefsStore` still writes to storage and the other stores after `close`
an enum option that is a CSS-wide keyword is written bare by `prefsCss`
`prefNodeAt` finds a nested section by its key, and `resetPlans` builds paths no leaf has
